summary: Russian forces conducted extensive drone and missile attacks across Ukraine overnight, targeting infrastructure and civilian areas. Multiple strikes hit bridges, rail infrastructure, and residential locations across several regions including Kiev, Kharkiv, and Dnipro. Ukrainian air defenses reported intercepting numerous Shahed drones and Geran missiles.
key_points: Russian attacks hit bridges across the Dnieper in Zaporozhye, temporarily closing the Vantovy and Preobrazhensky bridges (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33733).
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 114 hostile drones including Shaheds, Geran missiles, and other types overnight (Source: @kpszsu/83263).
Strike on a bridge in Zaporizhzhia resulted in five casualties, including two Red Cross workers (Source: @UkraineNow/84509).
Russian forces reported destroying 868 Ukrainian drones overnight according to Russian Ministry of Defense (Source: @tass_agency/398982).
Multiple Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones targeted Kyiv region and other areas including Kharkiv and Dnipro (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76091).
Attack on infrastructure in Odesa region damaged a rocket-artillery storage facility and cargo ship in the port (Source: @tass_agency/398980).
Drone attack near Nosivka in Chernihiv region and attacks near Kropyvnytskyi in Dnipro region caused damage and casualties (Source: @eRadarrua/120390).
Railway infrastructure under attack has depleted Ukraine's locomotive reserves, prompting negotiations with European partners for additional rolling stock (Source: @UkraineNow/84495).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched a coordinated overnight attack using drones and missiles across multiple Ukrainian regions, targeting critical infrastructure including bridges, railways, and residential areas. Ukrainian air defenses successfully intercepted 114 hostile drones and missiles, though several strikes penetrated defenses causing casualties and infrastructure damage. The attacks have significantly impacted Ukraine's railway system, depleting locomotive reserves and prompting urgent negotiations with European partners for replacement rolling stock.

points: Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 114 hostile drones including Shahed-136/131 types, Gerbera, Bandarol/Dan-T drones, and Parody imitator drones from directions including Kursk, Shtalovo, and Russian-occupied territories (Source: @kpszsu/83263).

Railway infrastructure attacks have depleted Ukraine's locomotive reserves, leading to negotiations with European partners for additional rolling stock of compatible gauge (Source: @UkraineNow/84495).
Drone threats triggered multiple air raid alerts across Kyiv and surrounding regions, with yellow alert levels issued at 06:07 and 01:24 local time (Source: @eRadarrua/120384, @eRadarrua/120366).
Attacks on bridges across the Dnieper in Zaporizhzhia region temporarily closed the Vantovy and Preobrazhensky bridges (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33733).
Strike on one of the bridges through the Dnieper in Zaporizhzhia resulted in five casualties, including two Red Cross workers (Source: @UkraineNow/84509).
Russian Ministry of Defense reported shooting down 868 Ukrainian drones overnight according to official statement (Source: @tass_agency/398982).
Russian forces claimed to have destroyed Ukrainian radar stations in Poltava and Odesa regions using 'Geran' missiles (Source: @tass_agency/398967).
Russian aviation bombers destroyed a temporary deployment point of the 15th Separate Special Purpose Brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in the DPR (Source: @tass_agency/398967).

Russian forces reported hitting a rocket-artillery storage facility in Ilyivka, Odesa region, and damaging a cargo ship carrying dual-use goods in the port of Chornomorsk (Source: @tass_agency/398980).
Russian forces claimed to have destroyed an aerostat with Starlink module using 'Varag' unmanned system operators at altitude over 10 km (Source: @tass_agency/398972).
Multiple Shahed and Geran missile attacks targeted Kharkiv region, with reports of impacts near Nosivka and Kupiansk (Source: @eRadarrua/120390, @kpszsu/83253).
Drone attacks were reported near Kupiansk in Kharkiv region from northern direction (Source: @kpszsu/83253).
Attacks on infrastructure in Kharkiv region included multiple Geran missiles targeting the capital region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76091).
Russian forces reported destroying Ukrainian radar stations in Poltava region using 'Geran' missiles (Source: @tass_agency/398967).
Multiple Geran-5 missiles and drone threats targeted Kyiv region, with impacts reported near Vyshgorod and Brovary (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76101, @kpszsu/83204).
Air raid alerts were issued for Kyiv at 06:07 and 01:24 local time due to drone threats (Source: @eRadarrua/120384, @eRadarrua/120366).
Geran-5 missiles launched from Chernihiv region targeted Kyiv region, specifically Vyshgorod district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76101).
Drone threats were detected near Brovary from Chernihiv region, with three reactive drones reported in that direction (Source: @eRadarrua/120369).
Bridge attacks across the Dnieper in Zaporizhzhia region temporarily closed the Vantovy and Preobrazhensky bridges (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33733).
Strike on bridge infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia resulted in five casualties, including two Red Cross workers (Source: @UkraineNow/84509).
Russian forces reported damaging a cargo ship in the port of Chornomorsk carrying dual-use goods for the Ukrainian Armed Forces (Source: @tass_agency/398980).
Attack on infrastructure in Odesa region damaged a rocket-artillery storage facility in Ilyivka (Source: @tass_agency/398980).
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 114 hostile drones and missiles overnight, including Shahed-136/131, Gerbera, Bandarol, and Parody types (Source: @kpszsu/83263).
Multiple Geran-5 missiles were detected over Kyiv and other regions, with launches reported from Chernihiv, Kharkiv, and other areas (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76087, @mon1tor_ua/76090, @mon1tor_ua/76100).
Russian forces claimed to have destroyed Ukrainian aerostat with Starlink module using 'Varag' system at altitude over 10 km (Source: @tass_agency/398972).
Drone attacks were detected near Kupiansk in Kharkiv region and other locations from northern directions (Source: @kpszsu/83253, @kpszsu/83262, @kpszsu/83264).

key_developments: Russian forces launched coordinated overnight drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, with Ukrainian air defenses intercepting 114 hostile drones and missiles including Shaheds and Geran missiles from multiple directions (Source: @kpszsu/83263).

Critical infrastructure strikes hit bridges across the Dnieper in Zaporizhzhia, temporarily closing the Vantovy and Preobrazhensky bridges, with five casualties reported including two Red Cross workers (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33733, @UkraineNow/84509).

Railway infrastructure under sustained attack has depleted Ukraine's locomotive reserves, prompting urgent negotiations with European partners for additional rolling stock of compatible gauge (Source: @UkraineNow/84495).

Russian forces reported destroying Ukrainian radar stations in Poltava and Odesa regions using 'Geran' missiles and claimed to have eliminated a temporary deployment point of the 15th Separate Special Purpose Brigade in the DPR (Source: @tass_agency/398967).

Multiple Geran-5 missiles and drone threats targeted Kyiv region overnight, triggering air raid alerts at 06:07 and 01:24 local time, with impacts reported near Vyshgorod and other locations (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76091, @mon1tor_ua/76101).

Attack on infrastructure in Odesa region damaged a rocket-artillery storage facility in Ilyivka and a cargo ship in the port of Chornomorsk carrying dual-use goods for Ukrainian forces (Source: @tass_agency/398980).

Russian Ministry of Defense claimed to have shot down 868 Ukrainian drones overnight, while Ukrainian sources reported 17 confirmed impact locations and debris fall in 4 areas from the overnight attacks (Source: @tass_agency/398982, @kpszsu/83263).
sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating their use of drone and missile attacks against Ukrainian critical infrastructure, with coordinated overnight strikes targeting bridges, railways, and residential areas across multiple regions. The depletion of Ukraine's locomotive reserves represents a significant operational impact that could affect military logistics and civilian transportation. Ukrainian air defenses are demonstrating effectiveness in intercepting hostile drones, but penetration of defenses continues to cause casualties and infrastructure damage. The attacks suggest preparation for potential larger-scale operations, with emphasis on degrading Ukraine's ability to sustain military operations.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian authorities are coordinating with European partners to address the critical shortage of locomotives caused by Russian attacks on railway infrastructure, seeking replacement rolling stock with compatible gauge specifications. The attacks on bridges and ports in the south have disrupted transportation and logistics networks, requiring immediate defensive measures and repair efforts. Air raid alert systems have been activated repeatedly across Kyiv and surrounding regions, indicating sustained threat environment. The targeting of Red Cross facilities and civilian infrastructure suggests deliberate efforts to impact humanitarian operations and civilian morale.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian coordination of multiple drone launch directions simultaneously suggests improved command and control capabilities in targeting Ukrainian infrastructure. The use of both Shahed and Geran missile types indicates diversified supply chains and targeting methodologies. Ukrainian reports of 17 confirmed impact locations with debris fall suggest some attacks penetrated air defenses despite interception efforts. The targeting of dual-use cargo ships and railway infrastructure indicates focus on degrading Ukraine's economic and military logistics capabilities.
